description: Score the HEMO Q432/R433 site against published ADAM10, ADAM17, MMP, furin and BACE subsite preferences, and compare stalk geometry with an ADAM substrate reference set
code:
import requests, os, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9H9K5.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
site = dict(P4=seq[428],P3=seq[429],P2=seq[430],P1=seq[431],
            P1p=seq[432],P2p=seq[433],P3p=seq[434],P4p=seq[435])
print("HEMO Q432/R433 octamer P4-P4':", "".join(site.values()), site)

# Published subsite preferences (sources cited in the report)
prefs = {
 'ADAM10':  {'P1':set('AGSV'),        'P1p':set('LYFWM'),  'note':"P1' Leu + aromatic (Tucher 2014, PMID 24635658)"},
 'ADAM17':  {'P1':set('AGS'),         'P1p':set('VLA'),    'note':"P1' Val>Leu; P3/P2/P1' critical (PMID 24635658, 28143719)"},
 'MT-MMPs / MMPs': {'P3':set('P'),    'P1p':set('LIMFV'),  'note':"canonical Pxx|Hy: Pro at P3, hydrophobic at P1'"},
 'Furin / PCSK':   {'P4':set('R'),    'P2':set('KR'),'P1':set('R'), 'note':"R-X-[KR]-R|"},
 'BACE1/BACE2 (A1)':{'P1':set('LMFY'),'P1p':set('DAEV'),   'note':"P1 hydrophobic, P1' small/acidic (beta-site type)"},
}
rows=[]
for fam,d in prefs.items():
    tested=[k for k in d if k!='note']
    hits=[k for k in tested if site[k] in d[k]]
    rows.append(dict(family=fam,
                     subsites_tested=",".join(tested),
                     observed="/".join(f"{k}={site[k]}" for k in tested),
                     n_match=len(hits), n_tested=len(tested),
                     matched=",".join(hits) if hits else "none",
                     basis=d['note']))
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\n=== Does the HEMO Q432/R433 site match any family's published subsite preference? ===")
print(tab[['family','observed','n_match','n_tested','matched']].to_string(index=False))

# Distance-to-membrane reference set (P1 -> first TM residue)
ref=pd.DataFrame([
 ("TNF-alpha","ADAM17","A76/V77",12,"A","V"),("TGF-alpha","ADAM17","A89/V90",9,"A","V"),
 ("APP alpha-site","ADAM10","K687/L688",12,"K","L"),("Notch1 S2","ADAM10","A1710/V1711",12,"A","V"),
 ("IL-6R","ADAM17","Q357/D358",10,"Q","D"),("CX3CL1","ADAM10/17","~juxtamembrane",8,"-","-"),
 ("L-selectin","ADAM17","K283/S284",11,"K","S"),("GPIb-alpha","ADAM17","G464/V465",19,"G","V"),
 ("FcgRIIIA/CD16A","ADAM17","A195/V196",24,"A","V"),
 ("HEMO/ERVMER34-1","unknown","Q432/R433",57,"Q","R")],
 columns=["substrate","protease","site","dist_P1_to_TM","P1","P1prime"])
print("\n=== Stalk geometry and P1/P1' of ADAM substrates vs HEMO ===")
print(ref.to_string(index=False))
known=ref[ref.substrate!="HEMO/ERVMER34-1"].dist_P1_to_TM
print(f"\nADAM reference set: median {known.median():.0f} aa, range {known.min()}-{known.max()} aa, mean {known.mean():.1f}+/-{known.std():.1f}")
z=(57-known.mean())/known.std(); print(f"HEMO Q432 at 57 aa -> z = {z:.1f} relative to the reference set")

out=os.getcwd(); print("\nwriting tables to", out)
tab.to_csv(os.path.join(out,"ERVMER34-1_protease_family_subsite_match.csv"),index=False)
ref.to_csv(os.path.join(out,"ERVMER34-1_stalk_geometry_reference.csv"),index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5))
ax=axes[0]
ax.barh(tab.family, tab.n_match/tab.n_tested, color=['#a0aec0']*4+['#a0aec0'])
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_xlabel("fraction of published subsite preferences matched by Q432/R433")
ax.set_title("No protease family's sequence preference\nis matched by the HEMO site")
for i,r_ in tab.iterrows():
    ax.text(0.02,i,f"{r_.observed}   ({r_.n_match}/{r_.n_tested})",va='center',fontsize=8.5)
ax=axes[1]
col=['#90cdf4']*9+['#e53e3e']
ax.barh(ref.substrate, ref.dist_P1_to_TM, color=col)
ax.axvspan(0,25,color='grey',alpha=.15)
ax.set_xlabel("residues from scissile bond (P1) to first TM residue")
ax.set_title("HEMO Q432 lies far outside the\nADAM10/17 juxtamembrane window")
for i,v in enumerate(ref.dist_P1_to_TM): ax.text(v+1,i,str(v),va='center',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
